semgrep_pin_note: The version Vibe Killer v1.0.0 pins in its own CI (pip install semgrep==1.185.0). Killer pins it because the silent half of its rule-pack assertion -- the pack staying quiet on the patched fixture -- is sensitive to the engine and not only to the rules. Giver verifies a static fix by reading that silence, so a pack gone quiet under a different engine does not fail here, it succeeds; see killer.GuardStaticAbsence. This is Killer's stated reasoning, not a measurement taken here: no engine-version-induced silence has been observed in this repository.
